sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
Leading the Standard in Petroleum Transportation

Zero Waste Haulage & Logistics Limited, operating as Zero Waste Petroleum Transport Co, is a premier oil and gas transportation company headquartered in Abuja, Nigeria. Founded and led by experienced power infrastructure engineers, we bring technical precision and safety excellence to every haul.

Our commitment to zero waste and zero incidents drives everything we do. We combine industry-leading safety protocols with modern fleet management and real-time tracking to ensure your petroleum products arrive safely, on time, every time.

With our strategic location in Abuja and nationwide coverage, we serve major oil marketers, independent dealers, and industrial clients across Nigeria's oil and gas sector.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Comprehensive Petroleum Transportation Solutions

Bulk Petroleum Haulage
Safe transportation of petrol (PMS), diesel (AGO), kerosene (DPK), and other petroleum products across Nigeria. Our modern fleet meets all regulatory requirements and safety standards.

Depot-to-Station Logistics
Reliable depot pickup and delivery to filling stations nationwide. Real-time tracking and delivery confirmation for complete transparency and accountability.

Industrial Supply Services
Dedicated transportation solutions for industrial clients requiring consistent petroleum product supply. Flexible scheduling and volume commitments tailored to your operations.

Fleet Management & Tracking
Advanced GPS tracking on all vehicles. Real-time monitoring, route optimization, and instant alerts ensure security and efficiency from loading to delivery.

Compliance & Safety Management
Full regulatory compliance with DPR standards. Comprehensive insurance coverage, certified drivers, and rigorous safety protocols on every trip.

sections.name: Why Choose Zero Waste
sections.copy:
The Zero Waste Difference

Engineering Excellence
Led by power infrastructure engineers who understand technical precision. We apply engineering rigor to logistics, ensuring optimal safety and efficiency in every operation.

Zero Tolerance Safety Culture
Our name reflects our commitment: zero waste, zero incidents, zero compromise. Comprehensive safety training, regular vehicle maintenance, and strict adherence to all safety protocols.

Modern Fleet & Technology
Well-maintained, compliant tankers equipped with advanced safety features. Real-time GPS tracking and digital documentation for complete transparency.

Nationwide Coverage
Strategically located in Abuja with the capacity to serve clients across all Nigerian states. Reliable delivery schedules you can depend on.

Regulatory Compliance
Fully licensed and compliant with all DPR regulations. Comprehensive insurance coverage and proper documentation for every delivery.
